rows.name:
A brave Defence Force soldier has gone off alone[XENO:n ]
and hasn't been back for some time.[XENO:n ]
Check on the soldier who went to the Cylinder Hangar.

Speak to the Defence Force soldier[XENO:n ]
near the Cylinder Hangar in Colony 9.
You confirmed that the soldier acting alone was safe.

Spider cocoon silk reportedly sells for a high price.[XENO:n ]
Help improve the life of a Defence Force soldier with[XENO:n ]
six children by gathering the materials.

Obtain 3 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Spide Cocoon Silk[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Worker Spides in Tephra Cave.
All that cocoon silk has helped his family prosper.

A Defence Force soldier wants to thank you.[XENO:n ]
He'll give you something he buried on a trip to Colony 6.[XENO:n ]
Go to the spot he described and dig it up.
After leaving Tephra Cave, search the ground to the left.
You found what the Defence Force soldier had hidden.

Many monsters are reportedly appearing in the passage[XENO:n ]
leading deeper into Tephra Cave.[XENO:n ]
Defeat them so the soldier can pass safely.

Near the Spring of Grief in Tephra Cave,[XENO:n ]
defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Devoted Spides[/System:Color].

Near the Spring of Grief in Tephra Cave,[XENO:n ]
defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Resolute Spides[/System:Color].

Near the Spring of Grief in Tephra Cave,[XENO:n ]
defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Zealous Spides[/System:Color].

You defeated the monsters near the Spring of Grief[XENO:n ]
and secured the route.

Shura came to study the Giants' ruins but is stuck[XENO:n ]
on her own. First, obtain the book with clues[XENO:n ]
to opening the door to Bafalgar Tomb.

Near Vilia Lake in Tephra Cave,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Starlight Book[/System:Color].
Report to Shura.

You obtained the Starlight Book.[XENO:n ]
It should reveal how to open the hidden door.

According to the Starlight Book, opening the door[XENO:n ]
requires an offering.[XENO:n ]
Obtain the White Spider Heart and offer it at the altar.

Defeat Dazzling Tolosnia near Mercy's Skylight[XENO:n ]
and obtain the [System:Color name=item ]White Spider Heart[/System:Color].
Offer the White Spider Heart at Bafalgar Tomb's altar.
Report to Shura.

The door opened when you offered the White Spider Heart.[XENO:n ]
You can finally enter.

The door is open, but Shura doesn't want to go inside.[XENO:n ]
Investigate Bafalgar Tomb's Prayer Room.
Enter Bafalgar Tomb's Prayer Room and investigate.
Report to Shura.

Near the Path of Purification in Tephra Cave,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Sacrificial Tablet[/System:Color].
Report to Shura.

There wasn't much of note inside the tomb,[XENO:n ]
but you prepared to open another door.

Research at Bafalgar Tomb has reached its final stage.[XENO:n ]
Open the hidden door and obtain an important clue[XENO:n ]
from the Suzerain's Crypt.

In the Suzerain's Crypt in Tephra Cave,[XENO:n ]
obtain a clue for the research.
Report to Shura.

You obtained the Moonlight Book and gave it to Shura.[XENO:n ]
With the Starlight Book, her research should advance.

You helped Shura research Bafalgar Tomb,[XENO:n ]
but she didn't have a reward on hand.[XENO:n ]
Visit her in Colony 9 to receive it.

In Colony 9's Commercial District,[XENO:n ]
talk to Shura.

To thank you for your help at Bafalgar Tomb,[XENO:n ]
Shura has presented a family heirloom.

A Defence Force soldier is having trouble gathering[XENO:n ]
materials to rebuild Colony 9 and asked for help.[XENO:n ]
Gather the collectables.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Kneecap Rocks[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.

You fulfilled the Defence Force soldier's request.[XENO:n ]
They should help repair the damaged buildings.

A Defence Force soldier is having trouble gathering[XENO:n ]
materials to rebuild Colony 9 and asked for help.[XENO:n ]
Gather the collectables.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Bright Figs[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.

You fulfilled the Defence Force soldier's request.[XENO:n ]
They should be served to the dispirited children.

A Defence Force soldier is having trouble gathering[XENO:n ]
materials to rebuild Colony 9 and asked for help.[XENO:n ]
Gather the materials.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Broken Pincers[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Cribes in Tephra Cave.

You fulfilled the Defence Force soldier's request.[XENO:n ]
They should help repair the anti-air batteries.

A Defence Force soldier is having trouble gathering[XENO:n ]
materials to rebuild Colony 9 and asked for help.[XENO:n ]
Gather the materials.

Obtain 1 lot of [System:Color name=item ]Grog Smelling Salts[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Noble Grogs in Tephra Cave.

You fulfilled the Defence Force soldier's request.[XENO:n ]
They should be used to help the injured.
